# Leisure and Me

> > A travel and lifestyle blog featuring destination guides, family travel itineraries, and cultural experiences across Asia, Latin America, and beyond.

Leisure and Me focuses on family-friendly travel with detailed guides to destinations in Sri Lanka, Singapore, Malaysia, Myanmar, and Latin America. The blog also covers wedding planning, photography, product reviews, and lifestyle content for travelers and families.

## Key Topics

- Sri Lanka travel and culture
- Family travel with kids
- Southeast Asia destinations (Singapore, Malaysia, Myanmar)
- Destination weddings
- Temple and cultural site guides
- Travel photography
- Latin America family holidays
- Cruise line selection
- Travel fitness and preparation
- Wordless Wednesday photography
- Historical sites (Polonnaruwa, Tissamaharama)
- Beach and resort destinations
- Game of Thrones filming locations
- Travel itinerary planning
- Wildlife and nature photography

- [Our Singapore Itinerary for 5 Days Trip (with kids)](https://leisureandme.com/singapore-itinerary-for-5-days-trip-with-kids): 5-day Singapore family itinerary featuring Sentosa and Marina Bay

- [Latin America with the Little Ones: The Best Family Holidays](https://leisureandme.com/latin-america-with-the-little-ones-the-best-family-holidays): Family travel guide to Latin America destinations including Montevideo
- [The Time to Make our New Year Resolutions is Here. Make Sure they Include Traveling to Peru!](https://leisureandme.com/new-year-resolutions-include-traveling-to-peru): Peru travel guide featuring Machu Picchu and Cusco for New Year planning
